bits: R=1 N=2 A=4; all candidates use double Q/K and QK with FP32 outputs and saved Q/K
rounding_contract: S0 calls unchanged anchored FP32 LN oracle. R selects direct two-pass double mean/center/variance. R-N continuous uses double variance directly. R without N rounds center and rms to FP32 before existing hypot normalization. Without R, existing anchored Kahan mean/amax/squares/rms are FP32. N selects double epsilon/sqrt/reciprocal and normalized multiply; h stays double only when A also selected. Inverse and xhat saved outputs always FP32. A selects double gamma product/beta sum and rounds final Y. Without A, h is rounded before separate FP32 gamma product and beta sum. All-high S7 must word-match C7 Y/xhat/inverse/Q/K/raw/P. Epsilon is source float 1e-5f. Both legacy/source ideal references retained.
development: Original frozen 44x2x25, same frozen 24x2, existing holdout 16x2x8. Both epsilon references and both Host Softmax models. No additional arithmetic variants planned.
selection: Freeze development PASS candidates in selection-private.json before confirmation. Rank by double LN operation groups R/N/A, then actual operation counts, saved representation consistency and ABI risk. Confirmation evaluates selected candidate plus S0/S7 anchors exactly once; failure is retained, no reselection on confirmation results.

confirmation.generator: Same uint32 LCG as prior holdout; generate X,dy,gamma,beta,Wq,Wk in that order. Independent seeds and weights; no checkpoint values.
patterns: head asymmetric weights column<32 scale .07 else .18
confirmation.gradient: Independent generated dp then dc per head. dp magnitudes cycle 4,32,256,512; dc alternate 2,16. Mixed signs, no frozen gradient9/12 copy. Cartesian16x2x8=256.
confirmation.limitations: Synthetic finite stress, no actual training matched trajectory. All gates fixed; do not discard seeds after evaluation.

prototype: At most one bounded geometry. Entry requires selected candidate full original contract and independent confirmation, defined saved-state/ABI, pinned codegen and current safe device. Otherwise complete Host/design/audit and report NOT IMPLEMENTED/NOT MEASURED.
